[Issue #8842] Create an opportunity publish workflow (#9195)

## Summary
Fixes #8842

## Changes proposed
* Sets up an opportunity publish workflow - no functionality on
transitions yet
* Add docs for how to create a workflow - some more specific details
will come in a later ticket

## Context for reviewers
This sets up a workflow for opportunity publishing that handles
automating a few things when an opportunity gets published, although
none of that logic is connected yet.

## Validation steps
Run the API locally while running the workflow service with `make cmd
args="workflow workflow-main"`.

Find an opportunity in your local DB and you can call the PUT workflow
endpoint by setting that as the entity ID in a request like below using
the `internal_workflow_user_key` user API key.

```json
{
  "event_type": "start_workflow",
  "start_workflow_context": {
    "entity_id": "1b0f1981-35c4-42d9-840f-bdc7054a7842",
    "entity_type": "opportunity",
    "workflow_type": "opportunity_publish"
  }
}
```

This'll immediately run through the whole workflow. If you look in the
`api.workflow_event_history` table you can find the workflow ID using
the event ID - you'll see just one event in this table, but 5
transitions in the workflow_audit table.
